title: Crowdwork Copilot
creator: Cary Chan
summary: A text-based audience simulator that returns structured reactions from three audience personas so comedians can test and revise stand-up material.
gemmaUse: Instruction-tuned Gemma 2B with few-shot prompting produces persona-specific reactions and feedback in a Gradio notebook.

title: Humor Genome Studio
creator: Aryan Yadav
summary: A modular browser workbench for creating, explaining, adapting, analyzing and performing humor through six dedicated tools.
gemmaUse: Task-specific structured prompts call Gemma through Google AI Studio; a shared pipeline validates, retries, repairs and can critique outputs across modules.

title: Killjoy: the AI that explains why it's funny
creator: Musliadi
summary: An interactive meme explainer that identifies a joke's mechanism, cultural reference, likely audience and the cost of explaining it.
gemmaUse: Sends the image to Gemma 4 in one multimodal call and requests five structured fields, including a self-aware "funniness lost" score.

title: LaughLens AI: Gemma Powered Humor Intelligence Platform
creator: Warrior
summary: A humor-intelligence research concept centered on generating jokes, evaluating humor quality and examining patterns such as setup, surprise, context, timing and audience perception.
gemmaUse: The writeup presents Gemma as powering the platform but does not document the model integration.

title: LaughLensAI
creator: Abhishek Gaduputi
summary: A text-joke analysis tool that visualizes structural dimensions as a humor genome and compares Gemma's hypothesis with anonymous human ratings.
gemmaUse: Gemma 4 through the Google Gen AI SDK returns schema-validated analysis across nine humor dimensions; results are framed as hypotheses and compared with human feedback.

title: Room Sense Text: Same Joke, Four Gemma Audiences
creator: samuel tan
summary: A clonable Kaggle notebook that shows how one joke is received by four simulated audience personas and rewrites it for a colder room.
gemmaUse: Runs Gemma 4 through llama.cpp to produce four audience reactions, explain the joke's structure and risks, and rewrite it for a selected colder audience.

title: Why'd They Laugh? An Audience-Focused Feedback System
creator: okkotsu_senpai
summary: A performance-feedback prototype that analyzes recordings or text, compares detected audience laughter with Gemma's predicted beats and returns structured, timestamped notes.
gemmaUse: Gemma performs structured joke decomposition, audience simulation, frame-aware clip reasoning and targeted rewriting; audio signal processing supplies the measured laugh regions.
